details: This package is an unofficial, rebranded copy of the WhatsApp Web library Baileys published under a personal scope rather than the canonical @whiskeysockets scope, and it adds behaviour beyond the upstream library. lib/Socket/luxu.js hardcodes WhatsApp channel identifiers (120363421563597486@newsletter and 120363399602691477@newsletter) and injects them into forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo on outgoing status and poll messages, so messages sent through this library carry spoofed "forwarded from D | 7eppeli-Exloration" attribution promoting the fork author's channel. lib/Socket/socket.js exports an extra checkBan(number) API that sends the supplied phone number to the non-WhatsApp host hxxps://kyuux-r[.]indevs[.]in/api/check-whatsapp?phone=<number> and stamps the response with the handle t[.]me/luyatiem, giving an operator-controlled third party a feed of target phone numbers. package.json pins the native bridge whatsapp-rust-bridge at an exact version and declares a cache-manager range (^7.2.8) that resolves to a version known to be malicious, pulling a compromised dependency into any install. The lifecycle hook engine-requirements.js only parses the Node.js major version, and no eval/atob call sites or reads of process.env, ~/.npmrc, ~/.ssh or ~/.aws were present in the shipped code.
